historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly rejects agent execution but does not define the fault stimulus, ESD/power isolation, evidence timing or restoration controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly separates operator-only hardware work from agent-assisted SEL/log capture and prohibits automatic retry.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code/source search found no earlier V3.1 review for this identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The taped-pin pattern is an electrical fault definition, not a generic `bad DIMM`. Wrong pins can create a different symptom or damage the board. The operator must use a vendor-approved DIMM/slot-specific pattern and capture the first boot attempt before restoration.

original_test_intent: Validate that an approved, intentionally faulted DIMM in a specified motherboard slot is diagnosed during the first POST/MRC sequence with the expected early-screen, MRC/AGESA and SEL signatures, then restore and verify the known-good memory configuration.
original_method: With explicit owner approval, identify the DIMM/slot/pin fault contract, preserve baseline SEL and platform state, fully power-isolate and apply ESD controls, have an authorized operator tape/install the DIMM, capture the single first power-on POST/MRC/SEL sequence, stop on unsafe behavior, restore the known-good DIMM with AC isolated, and verify recovery without clearing evidence.
manual_activity: An authorized hardware operator performs the exact pin-taping, AC-isolated DIMM swap, first boot observation and known-good restoration; the agent may only capture read-only identity and SEL/log evidence.
required_inputs: Approved DIMM part and target slot
Owner approval for destructive fault injection
safety_requirements: Never let an agent handle or alter hardware
Never improvise pin selection or tape placement
Require full power removal and ESD controls
Perform only one approved stimulus boot
Stop on odor, heat, smoke, arcing, damage or uncontrolled boot loop
Do not clear SEL or system logs
Restore known-good hardware before further testing
agent_execution_scope: Collect post-stimulus SEL after operator action
Package evidence without touching hardware or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Approve operator, ESD and power isolation
Observe first POST and MRC/AGESA diagnosis
Direct immediate stop/recovery on unsafe behavior

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly supplies no automatic command because the decisive stimulus and early-screen evidence are physical. Its later SEL suggestion is supporting evidence only and cannot replace POST/MRC observation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No agent-executed fault command. Operator follows the approved physical procedure; the agent performs only read-only pre/post SEL and identity capture after explicit coordination.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The taped-pin bad-DIMM installation, first boot, early-screen/MRC/SEL checks and 30-minute activity remain; generic log clearing and repeated boots are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an evidence timeline for baseline, AC isolation, tape/slot photographs, first power-on console/MRC/SEL, power-off, known-good restoration and recovered boot, all tied to exact component identities.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds electrical fault-contract control, one-attempt limit and verified restoration without reducing the physical stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A later SEL entry alone cannot prove the early boot message, MRC channel/slot diagnosis or correct taped-pin stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Intentional contact masking can damage DIMM/socket/board or prevent recovery; safety and vendor authorization dominate test coverage.

project_override_considerations: Project must approve exact DIMM/slot/pins/tape, expected error codes/messages and MRC/AGESA maps, power-isolation/ESD steps, single-attempt rule and known-good recovery path. Master logs must be preserved, not cleared.
expected_evidence: Timestamped first POST screen/console and MRC/AGESA evidence
Correlated SEL event identifying expected slot/channel

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently define a physical bad-DIMM boot diagnostic. The unsafe generic clear is excluded but does not alter the objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual stimulus, evidence and recovery path are understandable and can proceed when approved resources exist. Execution is BLOCKED only if the pin method, operator, isolation, expected signatures or known-good recovery cannot be secured.

review_improvement: Turns a loosely described hardware fault into a single-shot, component-bound, evidence-preserving manual procedure with explicit recovery and agent limits.
independent_technical_reasoning: Masking different DIMM contacts can affect presence detect, SPD access, power or signal lanes and therefore produce unrelated faults or electrical damage. Because the source acceptance depends on a particular MRC diagnosis, the pin pattern is part of the test definition; physical photos, first-boot evidence and slot-correlated SEL are inseparable from the result.
